text.autoconfig.clearsight.title: Clear Sight Configuration
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.disabl: Removes the Warden and sculk shrieker darkness: both the closing fog and the screen dimming.
Removes the nausea screen distortion, for example from pufferfish. The nether portal wobble has its own timer and is untouched.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideEf: Hides the swirly potion effect particles on every entity, including your own. The effects themselves still work.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.clearP: See while stuck in powder snow.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideTo: Skips the full-screen totem pop-up and your own green particle burst. The sound and hearts tell the story, and other players popping totems still shows.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideHu: The screen no longer tilts when you take damage.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideMa: Removes camera overlays from worn equipment, like the carved pumpkin blur.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideFr: Removes the creeping frost edge from powder snow.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hidePo: Removes the purple swirl while standing in a nether portal.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideFi: Removes the rocket flame trail that blocks your view while boosting an elytra. Explosions are untouched.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideWe: Stops rendering falling rain and snow. The weather still happens, you just do not stare through it.
text.autoconfig.clearsight.option.hideDe: Removes the view and motion arrows from hitbox debug, keeping just the boxes.
